detail: Targets has a 100 ms budget; when the machine is loaded it can run out on an ordinary call (RC-93 (2)), and the enforcing guard then refuses it (analysis_limit). Measure how often real sessions hit analysis_limit or guard_timeout once the guard runs (orch spaces log), and raise the budget or retry if it matters. Also seen: TestTargetsAuditRound3Cost (internal/spaces) fails under -race on this Mac (a 2 MB Write took 565 ms), unrelated to SP-041's diff.
